headline: Exchanges Take In 981 Million Dollars As Bitcoin Trades Near 81k
narrative: Crypto exchanges took in 981 million dollars over 24 hours, equal to 0.3641 percent of reserves, as coins arrived on venues. Bitcoin exchange reserves rose by 29,293 coins over seven days and sat at the 96.7 percentile of the past 30 days, a distribution print in the spot pipe. Bitcoin traded near 81k, while options skew at 28.78 showed downside heavily bid into the Oct. 29 expiry, with puts struck at 73k and calls at 90k.
author: jordan
